text:
Marta: Heads up — FRA customs reclassified H100 units under a new HS code, truck got held at the gateway. AWB: 123-45678901. PO: RDW-73821. Vendor proposes split shipment: priority air for 4 units, rest by sea. Need decision: accept split + expedite (~€12k) or wait ~3–5 days for clearance. :grimacing:

Chris (NexaSupply): Hi Marta — confirmed hold. Customs flagged paperwork mismatch (commodity description). We can split and airlift 4x H100 (ETA ~48h) + sea for remainder (ETA ~10d). Expedited surcharge estimate €11,800 incl brokerage and carrier rush. RMA support for DOA units remains standard, we can pre-send return labels and open RMA now. Air AWB: ABX123456789.

Alex: Can procurement push that down to €9k? Finance won't approve €12k without CFO signoff. Any option to credit next shipment or reallocate allocation budget?

Chris (NexaSupply): Pushing. Two levers: (1) waive one day's broker storage (~€1.2k), (2) credit on next PO if you commit to the remaining lot. Best immediate: €9,800 with PO amendment today. Need official amendment to process.

Marta: OK — send PO amendment + proforma. Billing must show "Redwood Inference" as bill-to. Also confirm serials on expedited units are contiguous so fleet tagging scripts don't break.

Chris (NexaSupply): Amendment (proforma link sent to Marta via email). Serials for expedited: H100-SN-9001..9004. Sea batch: H100-SN-9005..9024. Invoice ref will include expedited surcharge line.

Devon: ops note — if we accept split, request FRA depot staging for QC on arrival. Don't auto-deploy to clusters until depot photo evidence + POST power test.

ops-bot: Task created: `task-73821-staging-check` assigned to @Devon — checklist: photos, serial reconciliation, burn-in 15m, power test.

Gina: Heads up on infra side — private cluster KMS keys and rack onboarding take time. If airlift: expect ~72h to physical install + ~24h for integration testing once unit is in rack. Might impact customer rollouts.

Alex: Given the timeline, we should accept split at €9,800. Marta, secure amendment and confirm invoice coding to cost center INFRA-GPU.

Marta: Accepted. Chris — please proceed with amendment and send AWB docs + expedited invoice to billing@redwood.ai. Also cc devex for serial mapping. :thumbsup:

Chris (NexaSupply): Will do. Opening RMA ticket for potential DOA on arrival: RMA-2026-778. Pre-staging labels attached, carrier ETA update to follow.

Marta: Thanks. Please include photos from carrier pickup if possible.

Devon: Quick diagnostics note — pulled last logs from the provisioner before the hold:
```
$ docker logs gpu-provisioner | tail -n 20
2026-03-18T09:12:01Z provisioner: sync OK
2026-03-18T09:12:05Z inventory: 0 pending shipments
2026-03-18T09:12:07Z healthcheck: all clusters green
```
No pre-shipment anomalies.

Ian: (infra) Will reserve 2U rack space in FRA-1 and pre-stage 1U rail kits. Drop us the expected install window once AWB updates come in.

Marta: Noted and updated task. Chris: once amendment is signed, can you also confirm customs broker contact and provide signed commercial invoice PDF? We need that to avoid another hold.

Chris (NexaSupply): Yes — sending broker contact and signed commercial invoice to billing + customs@redwood.ai in next 30m.

Marta: Great. Closing here unless anything else.

Devon: Follow-up — once units are in staging, please upload depot photos to the staging task thread and ping infra.

Alex: Thanks team.
